turns.question: Which channel brought us the most bookings in September 2026, and how many?
turns.answer: Search brought the most bookings in September 2026 (2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30), with 31 bookings (ahead of social with 20 and email with 3). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
